tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground: cream paper. Always carries the paper-noise texture (see bundle.css body).

tokens.name: paper-noise
tokens.usage: Ink of the SVG noise laid over background at 4.5% opacity. Never a fill or a text colour.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on background: product cards, inputs, order summary, table body, menus.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet fills on background or card: secondary button, table header, image placeholder, disabled controls.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading placeholders on background or card. Static, no shimmer.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on background, card and secondary (14.8:1 on background).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and placeholders on background (5.4:1), card (5.7:1) and secondary (4.7:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ember red. Primary buttons, prices, active nav underline, brush underlines, the first word of two-tone titles. As text on background (6.5:1), card and secondary (5.7:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons; hover colour of links.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary or primary-hover fill (6.7:1 and 8.6:1).

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Forest green. Eyebrows, value-prop titles, the second word of two-tone titles, paid and active badges, success, selected address. As text on background (10.9:1).

tokens.name: forest-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a forest fill (11.3:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: card outlines, row dividers, table lines. 1.8:1 on background, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: inputs, selects, quantity stepper, secondary and icon buttons, dashed tiles (3.6:1 on background, 3.1:1 on secondary).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Sits on background, card or secondary (9.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The double rule (two 1px lines, 5px apart) above and below the value props and above the footer.

tokens.name: rule-soft
tokens.usage: Vertical separators between value props and in the header tools.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors: invalid field border, error text, error alert. Shares the ember red, so it always comes with an icon and a message.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind an invalid field, an error alert and an overdrive sheep tile. Foreground and destructive text read on it (5.5:1).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the success alert. Forest text reads on it (9.6:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Text of the pending badge, on warning-soft (6.8:1).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the pending badge. Pale on purpose: paid is dark, pending is pale, cancelled is hollow.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Edge of the pending badge (3.6:1 on background).

tokens.name: ghost
tokens.usage: Dashed edge of a sheep tile whose container does not answer (3.3:1 on background).

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Home hero only. Fluid: clamp(68px, 6.3vw, 101px); under 700px drop to 44px so each sentence holds one line. Width 75%. First sentence primary, second forest. Paper-coloured outline when it overlaps the landscape.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, at the top. Fluid: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px). Width 75%.

styles.name: section-title
styles.sample: Pronti a partire. E a finire sulla brace.
styles.usage: Section headings, with the brush underline. Fluid: clamp(30px, 4vw, 44px). Width 75%.

styles.name: hero-subtitle
styles.usage: Line under the hero title. Fluid: clamp(20px, 2vw, 29px). Width 75%.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on cards, product page, totals. Primary colour, tabular figures. 20px in dense rows.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Product names on cards; 20px in cart rows.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Label of the 62px call to action.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase line above a title, in forest. One per title.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation; 15px under 700px and in the footer.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Carne di pecora tagliata a mano e infilata su spiedini di legno.
styles.usage: Default text. Never smaller in inputs (iOS zooms under 16px).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, field errors (at 600), legal line, badges (at 600).

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Uppercase table headers and sheep-tile metadata (metadata without the uppercase).

styles.name: hand-note
styles.usage: The handwritten aside, rotated about -6deg. At most one per screen, never for information the page needs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-edge nudges, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a stepper and its button, between header tools.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, alert padding, tile gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, default gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button padding, gap in cart rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Order summary padding, section inner gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links; call-to-action padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections under 700px.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections from 700px.

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Side margin of the page under 700px.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin of the page from 700px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, thumbnails, skeleton lines.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, stepper, images inside cards, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, order summary, address card, table wrapper, sheep tile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: CPU bar of the sheep tile. Nothing else is a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: The 62px call to action at rest. The only resting shadow in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-cta-hover
tokens.usage: The call to action on hover, with its 3px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: language menu, select popover.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content, centred.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, selects, stepper cells. Also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Height of the call to action.

tokens.name: hero-h-min
tokens.usage: Hero height floor: clamp(440px, 34vw, 540px).

tokens.name: hero-h-max
tokens.usage: Hero height ceiling.

tokens.name: bp-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest supported width.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Below: 18px gutters, two-row header, one-column grids, stacked cart rows.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: From here: three value props side by side, four-column product list.

tokens.name: bp-max
tokens.usage: Content stops growing.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap of the product grid; 16px under 700px.

tokens.name: grid-cols-sm
tokens.usage: Product-list columns under 700px.

tokens.name: grid-cols-md
tokens.usage: Product-list columns from 700px.

tokens.name: grid-cols-lg
tokens.usage: Product-list columns from 1000px. The home grid uses 3 row-cards instead.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover: colour, border, the call-to-action lift.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Focus and state changes; sheep tile calm, overdrive, ghost.

tokens.name: duration-cart
tokens.usage: Cart counter bump after an add.

tokens.name: duration-sway
tokens.usage: One loop of the hero airplane sway.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every transition. The airplane sway uses ease-in-out.
